gloss: the whole town; all over town; throughout the town

definitions.gloss: the whole town; all over town; throughout the town
definitions.explanation: The entire town or every part of it. The suffix {中|じゅう} attaches to time/place nouns to mean "throughout" or "everywhere within." Note that {町中|まちなか} (read differently) means "downtown" instead.

examples.japanese: そのうわさは{町中|まちじゅう}に{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: The rumor spread all over town.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りの{日|ひ}は{町中|まちじゅう}が{賑|にぎ}やかになる。
examples.english: On festival days, the whole town becomes lively.

examples.japanese: {迷子|まいご}の{犬|いぬ}を{探|さが}して{町中|まちじゅう}を{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}った。
examples.english: I walked all over town looking for the lost dog.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The same kanji {町中} has two readings with different meanings:
- まちじゅう: throughout the town (this entry)
- まちなか: in town; downtown area

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町中|まちじゅう}に{広|ひろ}まる: to spread throughout the town
- {町中|まちじゅう}{大騒|おおさわ}ぎ: the whole town in an uproar
- {町中|まちじゅう}を{探|さが}し{回|まわ}る: to search all over town

RELATED EXPRESSIONS WITH {中|じゅう}:
- {一日中|いちにちじゅう}: all day long
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}: all over the world
- {家中|いえじゅう}: throughout the house
